thread:
maria: Heads-up — scheduling a tf apply during the 02:00 change window for the cross-account IAM roles + transit gateway route update. Need a quick preflight and pin decision.

sam: on it. which stacks?

maria: infra-network (transit-gw), infra-iam (cross-account roles). plan ran in staging, no diffs except the new assume-role ARN.

cheng: thanks. can we pin provider versions and modules for this run? last time provider drift caused weird timeouts.

maria: yes. i'm going to pin aws provider 5.17.0 and module-vpc 3.2.1 for the apply. plan output included in the run. snippet:```terraform
provider "aws" {
  version = "~> 5.17.0"
}
module "vpc" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/mods/vpc.git//?ref=v3.2.1"
}```

olivia: we should add a canary for the route change — shift 5% traffic, monitor, then full switch. canary config in console is fine.

maria: agreed. i'm scheduling deploybot to run the staged apply with canary. deploybot: please queue: infra-network -> canary 5% -> wait 10m -> rest.

deploybot: queued apply 1744509876 by maria. sequence: infra-iam, infra-network(canary 5% then full). ETA start 2024-03-12T02:00Z.

sam: rollback criteria? success metrics?

maria: rollback if any of these within 10m of canary: 1) >2% increase 5xx errors from gateway logs, 2) route propagation errors in cloudwatch, 3) failed sts assume operations for cross-account. Manual abort allowed.

cheng: good. add an automated escape hatch to revert route table change if health checks fail. command to revert is in the runbook: `scripts/revert-tgw-route.sh --id tgw-rtb-03`
